title: SNP markers for QTL mapping in inbred lines
author: Rahman, Habibur
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Collect and freeze leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Harvest young leaves from the 175 inbred lines and their seven parents grown in a greenhouse; for each line combine ~200 mg of bulk leaf material from three plants, place into a 2 mL safe‑lock Eppendorf tube and store at –80 °C for one night before grinding.

steps.title: Grind frozen leaf material
steps.instruction: Crush the frozen leaf samples using a Mixer Mill (TissueLyser II, Qiagen, Germany).

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from the ground tissue using the SIGMA DNA extraction kit (Sigma‑Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Quantify DNA purity and concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity with a NanoDrop 2000c spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Wilmington, DE, USA).

steps.title: Digest DNA with restriction enzymes
steps.instruction: Digest each DNA sample with the restriction enzymes NSpI (5′‑RCATG^Y‑3′) and BfuCI/Sau3AI (5′‑^GATC‑3′) to generate 3′ and 5′ overhangs, respectively.

steps.title: Ligate barcode and universal oligos
steps.instruction: Ligate two single‑stranded oligonucleotides to the digested DNA: a sample‑specific internal barcode oligo to the 3′ overhang and a universal oligo to the 5′ overhang.

steps.title: Pool ligated DNA for library
steps.instruction: Combine the ligated DNA from all 175 inbred lines and the seven parents into a single pool for tGBS library construction.

steps.title: Prepare and submit tGBS library
steps.instruction: Submit the pooled DNA to Data2Bio (Ames, IW, USA) for library preparation and sequencing using the tunable genotyping‑by‑sequencing (tGBS®) method.

steps.title: Demultiplex sequencing reads
steps.instruction: Demultiplex the raw sequence data by barcode and remove the barcode sequences bioinformatically from each read.

steps.title: Trim low‑quality reads
steps.instruction: Trim the barcode‑removed reads with Lucy software, discarding bases with Phred quality scores below Q15.
